digest.title: FBI arrests OpenAI employee accused of planting hidden recording device in conference room
digest.tldr: It's not clear exactly for what purpose the recording device was used, but FBI director Kash Patel said the scheme was to "capture sensitive communications about the company’s super intelligence technology."

digest.title: OpenAI, Google pushing new AI models easily tricked into making nudes, researchers say
digest.tldr: Attack method exposes flaws in OpenAI, Google safeguards against AI nudes.

digest.title: Google DeepMind and Singapore Government collaborate to build fine-tuned AI model for scam detection
digest.tldr: Learn how Google DeepMind and GovTech Singapore uses lightweight on-device Gemma models to intercept conversational scams in private chats with zero cloud data egress.

digest.title: Microsoft: Recent Windows updates may trigger Remote Desktop failures
digest.tldr: Microsoft has confirmed that non-admin users may be unable to connect to devices via Remote Desktop after installing recent Windows updates if the "Administrator protection" security feature is enabled.
